title: Preserve the meaning of a voltage category instead of a plausible unrelated adverb
review_basis: Original manually viewed. Native independent GLM1.5.3 reviewer explicitly rejected figures[1] description after comparing the original; first source observation saved without schema retries and helper activation loops.
failure_oracle: «Оборудование на напряжение до1000В» is a voltage/upper-bound category. «Оборудование напрямую до1000В» changes its meaning. Faithful paraphrase is allowed, unsupported adverbs are not. Do not count template X-count or Э/З in a dummy stamp as additional engineering-accuracy gains.
